rawText:
David Chen
Senior Backend & Distributed Systems Engineer
San Francisco, CA | david.chen@example.test

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 6 years of experience designing scalable microservices, high-throughput message streaming systems, and low-latency database architectures using Node.js, Redis, and MongoDB.

EXPERIENCE
Starlight Media | Senior Backend Engineer
2021 - Present
- Architected high-throughput payment ingestion pipeline using Node.js, Express, and Redis caching handling 12,000 requests per second.
- Reduced database p95 query latency by 42% by restructuring MongoDB aggregation pipelines and introducing compound compound indexes.
- Mentored 5 junior and mid-level engineers on distributed systems design, asynchronous error handling, and test-driven development.
- Spearheaded migration from monolithic REST API to event-driven microservices using Apache Kafka and Docker.

CloudScale Solutions | Software Engineer
2018 - 2021
- Developed robust REST APIs in Node.js and TypeScript serving 400,000 daily active users.
- Integrated JWT authentication and bcrypt password hashing with Redis-backed session token revocation.
- Automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, cutting release deployment duration by 35%.
- Maintained 99.95% system uptime across multi-region AWS cloud deployments.

SKILLS
Languages & Frameworks: Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express, Python
Databases & Caching: MongoDB, Redis, PostgreSQL
Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Apache Kafka, AWS, GitHub Actions, Linux

EDUCATION
University of California, Davis
B.S. in Computer Science (2014 - 2018)
